line: Share your leftovers instead of letting them go to waste.
paragraph: A man in the Bronx saw a mother on the news who had lost everything to a house fire. He gathered what he could spare and gave it to her. Months later, she still speaks of the gift. The fire had taken her home, but his spare blankets and cartons of food carried her through the first empty weeks. She calls him a blessing. He had simply shared what was already his.

seed.summary: From the Bronx comes the story of a Good Samaritan who donated what he could spare to help a woman he’d seen on the news newly-impoverished at the hands of a house fire. Months later, and history now shows that it was this gesture of generosity which transformed the fire from a force of destruction,
seed.sourceTitle: Good Samaritan Helps Mother After Seeing Her Destroyed Home on the News: “He’s been a blessing”
